summary: Every effect now has its level 2, its form when the card sits on the mark it matched, and every one was re-read for uniqueness and fun by Opus 5.5 with Fable 5.1 reviewing each family. 1,526 live questions, 270 retired in place (187 this round: duplicates, twins where one effect's level 2 was another's level 1, and premises the game does not have). 172 had options rewritten; 207 carry a one-line flag saying why the effect may not earn a slot. Family AB is 21 new effects built around aiming at marks. Family AC (97 questions) asks the level 2 of every effect you had already ruled on, so no recorded answer changed meaning; its (d) keeps the effect with no level 2. One question is not in the list: is fame spendable? About fifteen options spend it. Q0011 and Q0047 are still the only answered questions that are retired.
